about: HypeCubeJam fixtures for the engine's web harness (Engine/Platforms/Wasm/Build/Tools/web/webrun.py run --fixtures <this file> --fixture <name>). Development stages only: the exec= steps run console commands (HCJMenuCmd), which a Shipping page refuses. See docs/DEVLOG_NOTES.md, item 28.

hcj_tour.about: title menu, hangar, settings, then PLAY and 100 s of a match against bots with page shots

hcj_soak.about: PLAY, then 10 minutes of a match (stability, memory every 10 s)

hcj_scores.about: PLAY, 75 s of the match, then the scoreboard (kills of every pilot) in a page shot

hcj_click_play.about: Shipping stages (no exec=): the start click, a click on PLAY in the title menu at 1920x1080 (y 425 since the Difficulty row sits above it, build 0.18.0 on; 365 before), then shots of the match; W held for a while

hcj_click_soak.about: Shipping stages: the start click, a click on PLAY, then 10 minutes of the match (the player's ship is not flown; it respawns by itself), memory every 10 s, shots at 5 and 10 minutes
